authority: AGENTS.md standing methods/source-fact authority; no scientific threshold adopted

reference_mask.basis: Existing TemplateFlow anatomical brain mask; common MNI152NLin2009cAsym res-2 source configuration and template metadata. Never derive support from source map values.
reference_mask.observed_encoding: Compute step 47586225.8: uint8 labels 0 (846195 voxels) and 255 (235840 voxels); float32 slope 0.003921568859368563, intercept 0; scaled levels 0 and 1.0000000591389835. Evidence: outputs/runs/grouped_evaluator_qualification/mask_text001/reference_diagnosis.json.
reference_mask.support_normalization: Require finite exactly two raw and scaled levels, scaled background exactly zero and foreground within one float32 epsilon of one. Map that exact discrete foreground to bool; do not threshold a multilevel/probabilistic mask.
reference_mask.compatibility: Reference binary/grid verification and separate header-only check of all 628 exact dataset_maps paths selected. No resampling or target-array access authorized.

signed_text.allowlist: Frozen factor names, level labels, declared category/control/order values, regressor kind/direction and explicitly redacted parametric-quantity phrases; exact model weights times adopted polarity.
signed_text.meaning_limits: Only adopted structured meanings; no inference for opaque codes or undocumented signed quantities. Missing descriptions remain unresolved, not exclusions or invented semantics.
signed_text.weight_matching: Within each exact map, use the producer census's lowercase-alphanumeric contrast-name normalization and full ordered definition match to frozen rounded TSV; retain unique exact source numeric strings without rounding or renormalizing. Embedded route models supply regressor transformations. Ambiguity stays unresolved; no fuzzy cross-map matching.
signed_text.role_compression: Distinct raw conditions can share the same adopted factor description. Preserve all weighted terms and disclose this limitation; these strings do not establish full semantic coverage.

lineage.basis: DATASETS.md source-facts table: Independence unit, adopted 2026-10-16
lineage.cross_accession_nonoverlap: assumed; generic subject labels and shared software/commits are not overlap evidence
lineage.required_merge_evidence: documented shared participants, first-level inputs or derivative lineage; record source and both accessions
lineage.legacy_partition_status: retain as provenance; not an EP03 eligibility filter

taxonomy.basis: Paradigm/task instructions and the adopted condition-role dictionary, without maps or scores. Family labels are coarse task contexts, not claims about neural mechanism.
taxonomy.sensitivity: Report family support and leave-one-family-out diagnostics. Any later methods-driven family revision is logged before scoring affected outcomes; never choose taxonomy by gain.

value_and_reward.rationale: Explicit reward/risk, outcome, incentive or choice paradigms; task contexts retain different condition-level computations for the residual model.
value_and_reward.assumption: Monetary outcome/choice is the coarse context even when social or motor factors coexist. MID variants use the adopted common template. No-map routes are retained.

feedback_classification_learning.rationale: Classification/weather-prediction with deterministic or probabilistic feedback; includes reversal of the learned assignment.
feedback_classification_learning.assumption: The two ds000002 classification routes inherit the paradigm-level feedback context of the documented probe route; they remain the same accession group.

response_control.rationale: Stopping, interference or instructed response suppression rather than passive sensory viewing.
response_control.assumption: Stopping, flanker and antisaccade are pooled as a broad response-control context; shared orientation rules remain unchanged.

emotion_regulation.rationale: Instructions to alter emotional responses relative to attend/observe controls, including instructed neurofeedback variants.
emotion_regulation.assumption: Feedback modalities are variants of the regulation context; physiological efficacy is not assumed.

language.rationale: Word/verb production or comprehension, lexical or sentence meaning, including pragmatic language contrasts.
language.assumption: Primary instruction is language despite social/pragmatic content. ds003545 remains screened out by the adopted timing hold.

visual_perception.rationale: Viewing or perceptually judging visual stimuli, including face/object identity, familiarity and expression.
visual_perception.assumption: Identity/expression and food viewing are pooled by visual task context; memory, emotion and value distinctions remain in condition descriptions.

social_judgment.rationale: Explicit judgments about belief, moral/social attributes or intentional agents.
social_judgment.assumption: Strategic human-versus-computer interaction shares this coarse context; no common neural mechanism is asserted.

working_memory.rationale: N-back maintenance/updating with target and lure conditions.
working_memory.assumption: 0-back is retained in its n-back paradigm family, not treated as a separate independent task.

prospective_memory.rationale: Face/scene prospective-memory targets embedded in an ongoing lexical-decision task, as recorded in both adopted role dictionaries.
prospective_memory.assumption: The em/wm filename alone does not recode these identical documented condition roles as episodic/working-memory families. Single-accession support is reported explicitly.

episodic_memory.rationale: Study, repeated encoding and later old/new retrieval of items.
episodic_memory.assumption: Encoding and retrieval share a coarse memory context; their contrasts remain separate observations within each accession.

motor_execution.rationale: Instructed motor acts, sequences or goal-directed movements.
motor_execution.assumption: Motor execution/feedback is a broad context. Unknown GDMotor go/no-go orientations and N=2 maps remain screened independently.

affective_induction.rationale: External emotional images and cued-recall imagery with documented valence and arousal factors.
affective_induction.assumption: Image viewing and internally recalled affect share the induction context; the methods do not say that identify is a passive face-identification task.

auditory_perception.rationale: Music and non-music auditory stimulation relative to control conditions.
auditory_perception.assumption: Single-accession support cannot establish cross-dataset transfer.

somatosensory_perception.rationale: Texture/vibration stimulus comparison under the adopted P/I reading.
somatosensory_perception.assumption: Adopted producer reading retained; prescribed sign sensitivity remains required.

gustatory_perception.rationale: Flavour/conditioned nutrient stimuli with their documented load factor.
gustatory_perception.assumption: Gustatory task context; no reward or satiety mechanism claim.

visuospatial_judgment.rationale: Line-bisection spatial judgment and control conditions.
visuospatial_judgment.assumption: Retain as a distinct paradigm rather than merging it to create cross-group support.

arithmetic.rationale: Arithmetic main/control instruction as represented in the route and role dictionary.
arithmetic.assumption: No promotion to language or working memory solely to improve family support.

neurofeedback_task.rationale: Task-NF/rest blocks and associated motor-imagery pre/post routes; the role dictionary supplies no more specific task instruction.
neurofeedback_task.assumption: Coarse neurofeedback context only; no motor-imagery mechanism inferred from a task filename.

unresolved_routes.ds004604/task-gas: No condition-role entry; gas task instructions need methods evidence.
unresolved_routes.ds005267/task-eye: CND codes and task instructions are unresolved; eye filename alone is insufficient.

normalization.target: source-sign-authenticated unthresholded group Z; float64 within a prospectively fixed common space and mask
normalization.operation: subtract each map's masked spatial mean then divide by its masked Euclidean norm; apply adopted s afterward
normalization.mask: Prospectively bind reference_mask above; no zero-based mask inference, target-dependent voxel removal, interpolation or imputation. Full target header compatibility remains pending.
normalization.nonfinite_or_constant: fail the affected evaluation; do not drop rows or modify support after scoring
normalization.predictions: do not renormalize prototypes or predictions; restore s to the complete canonical prototype plus residual
normalization.group_weights: uniform contrasts within group, then uniform groups; canonical family prototype averages within group before between groups
normalization.loss_ratio: compute group-level model and prototype MSE on identical rows, then 1 - model/prototype; no denominator epsilon, clipping, ratio of pooled losses or per-map ratio averaging
